RESPONSIBILITY AND COMPLIANCE STATEMENT

Dataset: Household mobility diaries, 2025 collection.
Depositor: Centre for Social Research.
Reference: CSR-2025-0417

Each diary entry records the participant's full name, date of birth, home
address, and the timestamped locations visited during the recording week.
Ethics approval REC-2025-041 applies. Consent was obtained for use of the
diaries in research analysis. Applicable jurisdiction: France.
